_comment: V2-405 — mutation testing on the security-invariant files (ADR-034 family / build-vs-buy-ledger.md). Answers 'would a test FAIL if this invariant broke?' where line coverage only proves a line RAN. /qa-tier, NOT warm /ship — the command runner re-executes the contract suite per mutant (minutes). Run: `npm run test:mutation` (all three files) or `npx stryker run --mutate lib/password.ts` for one. Scope is deliberately the three highest-value invariants, not the whole tree.
_commandNote: The command runs the tests that COVER the three mutated files (their invariant assertions), not the whole contract suite — mutation testing should execute the tests exercising the mutated code, and this also keeps sandbox-fragile scaffolding tests (enable-docs-site tsconfig patching) out of the run.

commandRunner.command: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import tsx --test tests/contracts/password.test.ts tests/contracts/auth.test.ts tests/contracts/api-auth.test.ts tests/contracts/audit-scrub.test.ts tests/contracts/scrub-completeness.test.ts tests/contracts/export-column-completeness.test.ts tests/contracts/sentry-scrub.test.ts
